text:
alex: Heads-up  Sales asked for a deterministic acceptance checklist before we commit to enterprise trials (BYOK + audit + retention). Want to propose a short, testable gate instead of ad-hoc signoffs.

diya: Strong yes. Can we make it 1-page: Scope, Acceptance tests, Cost cap, Rollback criteria. Engineers love checklists.

oscar: Engineering wishlist: key exchange handshake + rotation test, streaming audit writes with sample query load, export package with integrity proofs.

nora: Legal: need exported evidence to include per-record hash + manifest and a clear legal_hold flag. Also demand a custody log for who accessed exports.

alex: Good. Proposed SLA items: 
- BYOK: import/unwrap OK + rotation validated in staging
- Audit: hot index for last 90 days, background cold export for older windows
- Query SLA: 90th <= 2s for hot index, 95th <= 10s for export retrieval
- Retention: UI toggle + legal_hold prevents TTL purge

diya: Minor tweak: call it HOT=90d (<2s) and WARM=180-540d (best-effort but exportable within 24h). Don't promise sub-second for warm.

oscar: Cost note: hot indexing stream increases infra by ~25%. We'll need a per-tenant estimate sheet.

alex: I'll add a placeholder cost cap: "pilot <= $Y/month per tenant" for finance to replace.

nora: Also: data residency marker on exports. Exports must carry region tag in manifest.

oscar: For BYOK outage behavior: two modes preferred by customers: fail-closed (block model requests) or fallback-with-notice (use Redwood key + audit). Need policy per-account.

diya: Add acceptance test simulating KMS downtime and verifying behavior per account policy. Ops runbook must include emergency unwrap and audit trail.

alex: Drafting acceptance tests now. Example export manifest idea: 
```
{
 "manifest_version": "1.0",
 "tenant_id": "acct_123",
 "region": "eu-west-1",
 "generated_at": "2025-04-01T15:00:00Z",
 "items": [{"id":"evt_1","hash":"sha256:abc...","ts":"..."}],
 "legal_hold": false
}
```

nora: Perfect. Include signature block (HMAC) on manifest. For legal holds, we need an immutable flag in metadata and audit entries when toggled.

oscar: Monitoring requirements: alert if audit ingestion lag > 5m, KMS error rate > 0.5% over 5m, export job fail rate > 1%. Add dashboards and runbooks.

diya: I'll own monitoring spec.

alex: Action list: 
- alex: author one-page SLA checklist + example manifest (due Thu EOD)
- oscar: cost estimate & engineering delta (due Tue)
- diya: monitoring + KMS outage test spec (due Tue)
- nora: legal export language + custody requirements (due Mon)

ops-bot: Created event: "SLA gating: evidence + KMS runbook" Tue 11:00  invites: alex, diya, oscar, nora.

nora: Quick Q  export delivery mechanics: prefer S3 presigned + signed manifest. Ops: is that aligned?

oscar: Yes, presigned S3 is simplest. Also support scp/sftp for air-gapped customers as a follow-up.

diya: Also add TTL-override API for on-call with audit fields. We'll expose an endpoint and require 2-person approval for production.

alex: Great. This should give Sales a deterministic list to quote and Legal/Eng a clear set of pass/fail items. I'll circulate the doc when done.

nora: One more  include a rollback plan: automatic re-ingest if export manifest fails verification.

alex: Noted. Thanks all.
